product_name: Bajaj Life Group Superannuation Secure Plus
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-linked Non-Participating Life Group Superannuation Savings Plan
key_benefits: Employer-run Group Superannuation Scheme to manage and build a pension fund for employees, set up at Pooled-level policy account
On death or vesting, a minimum benefit of 101% of the member's contribution is payable
Annual investment return credited to the policy account; crediting rate = Max[x% * Gross Return, 1%] with a 1% minimum guaranteed crediting rate per financial year
Optional additional allocation on first-year contributions (with defined recovery %/period)
Funds earmarked under Group Non-Participating Controlled Fund

eligibility.note: Member entry/maturity age boundaries not recovered from this parse (brochure references an 'Important Details' table not captured). Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document (except where policy tenure is less than a year); refund less proportionate risk premium and medical/stamp-duty expenses; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.suicide_clause: No suicide exclusion — on death of the member due to suicide, the death benefit (minimum 101% of member's contribution) is payable. No exclusions apply.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: On death or vesting, minimum benefit of 101% of the member's contribution; bulk exits are subject to Market Value Adjustment (MVA).
key_terms.mva_note: Market Value Adjustment may apply to bulk exits (exits exceeding 25% of opening policy-account balance in a policy year) and on complete surrender.
key_terms.loan_note: No loans and no top-up contributions available under the scheme.
key_terms.tax_note: Premium and benefits 'may be eligible' for tax benefits per extant Income Tax Act; scheme approval under Part B of Fourth Schedule of Income Tax Act 1961; consult a tax consultant. GST per prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: The only guaranteed figures are the 1% minimum guaranteed crediting rate per financial year and the 101%-of-contribution minimum death/vesting benefit — any 'guaranteed' claim must be bounded to these.
The crediting rate is Max[x% * Gross Return, 1%] where x% is a board-set figure (95%-100%); returns above 1% are NOT guaranteed and depend on the backing fund's gross return.
Bulk exits and surrender are subject to Market Value Adjustment — any 'full value on exit' claim must be MVA-qualified.
This is an employer/trustee group superannuation product, not a retail individual pension.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT promise 'guaranteed returns' beyond the 1% minimum crediting rate — investment return above that is not guaranteed.
Do NOT omit Market Value Adjustment when describing exit/surrender values.
Do NOT market to individuals as a retail pension/annuity — it is a group superannuation scheme set up via trust/employer.
Do NOT imply loans or top-up contributions are available — they are not.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-linked Non-Participating Life Group Superannuation Savings Plan'
That investment return above the 1% minimum guaranteed crediting rate is not guaranteed and that Market Value Adjustment may apply
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / scheme rules for full terms
